## Usage

Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> to quit. See <a href="docs/guide.md">the *guide*</a> for details, and connect with ssh user@<host>.

E = mc<sup>2</sup>, H<sub>2</sub>O, <b>bold</b>, <i>italic</i> and <code>code</code>.

<details>
<summary>Installation from source</summary>

Build it with **Go**:

```sh
go install github.com/ekalinin/termd/cmd/termd@latest
```

<details>
<summary>Nested</summary>

A nested details block with a paragraph that is long enough to wrap at every width of the golden files.

</details>

</details>
